fields.value: Replication Data for: "Transmission Error Compensation for Industrial Robots Using Fourier Series"

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset contains all identification and validation data used in the conference paper "Transmission Error Compensation for Industrial Robots Using Fourier Series". The experimental data was recorded using an experimental setup to identify the transmission error of the gearboxes in a Stäubli TX2-40 as described in the paper. The data is divided into the two folders, "identification" and "validation" containing one file per measurement. The file names contain the parameter velocity setpoint q_set_dot in rad/s. Each measurement file contains a table with the input-side position theta in rad in the first column, joint angle setpoint q_set in rad in the second column, and the transmission error theta_TE in rad in the third column.
The MATLAB script "plot_figures.m" can be used to plot the position domain data from the figures 3 to 6 in the publication. The function "read_data.m" is applied to import all measurement data into two MATLAB structure arrays "identification" and "validation".
